- SBX YC-tag support - added tighter rules for checking valid tags. Supported types: 

 0+100+0, or 10+100I100+0, or no outer zeros -> simplex length (0, then 10) + duplex section (100, then 100I100), OR
 +100I100+0 -> no simplex length, duplex section (100I100)
 100++ -> all simplex

detail.readme:
# WiGiTS

WiGiTS is a universal open source suite of genome and transcriptome analysis tools for cancer research and diagnostics

![HMF_Pipeline](./pipeline/wigits.png)

The current release of the WiGiTs pipeline is v3.0. Release notes are [here](./pipeline/docs/v3_0/WiGiTs_v3.0_ReleaseNotes.pdf).

We recommend running WiGiTS with [Oncoanalyser](https://nf-co.re/oncoanalyser), a Nextflow implementation of the WiGiTS pipeline.

A detailed list of the resource files used to run the WiGiTs pipeline is [here](./pipeline/README_RESOURCES.md).
Download links to the resource files can be found on the [Oncoanalyser page](https://nf-co.re/oncoanalyser/docs/usage/#reference-data-urls).

The pipeline can be run on a targeted panel eg TSO500 - see detailed information [here](./pipeline/README_TARGETED.md).

## Pipeline overview
Here is a schematic showing how the interactions between the core molecular components of the tool suite:

![HMF_Pipeline](./pipeline/wigits_pipeline.png)

## Latest tool versions

Below are descriptions and download links for each tool used in the pipeline.

### DNA Tools

| Component                                      | Description                                                            | Current Version                                                                   |
|------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| [Amber](./amber/README.md)                     | Generate a tumor BAF file for Purple's copy number fit                 | [4.3](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/amber-v4.3)         |
| [BamTools](./bam-tools/README.md)              | BAM metrics and slicing                                                | [1.6.1](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/bam-tools-v1.6.1) |
| [Chord](https://github.com/UMCUGenetics/CHORD) | Homologous Recombination Deficiency detection                          | [2.2](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/chord-v2.2.0)       |
| [Cider](./cider/README.md)                     | TCR/BCR V(D)J recombination sequence detection                         | [1.2](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/cider-v1.2)         |
| [Cobalt](./cobalt/README.md)                   | Determines the read depth ratios for Purple's copy number fit          | [3.0](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/cobalt-v3.0)        |
| [Cuppa](./cuppa/README.md)                     | Tissue of origin prediction from WGS/WTS                               | [2.5](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/cuppa-v2.5.1)       |
| [Esvee](./esvee/README.md)                     | SV calling                                                             | [2.0](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/esvee-v2.0)         |

| [Neo](./neo/README.md)                         | Neoepitopes                                                            | [1.2](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/neo-v1.2)           |
| [Orange](./orange/README.md)                   | PDF summary report and JSON file of all WGS output                     | [5.0](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/orange-v5.0)        |

| [Purple](./purple/README.md)                   | Estimates copy number, purity and ploidy, and identifies driver events | [4.4](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/purple-v4.4)        |

| [Sage](./sage/README.md)                       | Point mutation variant calling and filtering                           | [5.0](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/sage-v5.0)          |
| [Teal](./teal/README.md)                       | Measures telomere content and estimates telomeric length               | [1.4](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/teal-v1.4)          |
| [Viridian](./viridian/README.md)               | Oncovirus presence and integration calling                             | [1.0](https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/releases/tag/viridian-v1.0)      |
